_meta.dual_fairness_principle: A FIXEO price is acceptable only if it simultaneously protects the client from arbitrary overpricing AND the artisan from economically unsustainable underpricing. FIXEO must NOT target the cheapest market price. FIXEO should target a defensible central fair price. The objective is CLIENT_FAIRNESS + ARTISAN_VIABILITY + PRICE_PREDICTABILITY + CLEAR_SCOPE — not lowest-price competition.
_meta.complexity_escape_doctrine: A FIXEO fixed price must NEVER silently increase. If the artisan discovers the real intervention falls outside the approved standard scope: (1) stop before additional work; (2) identify the objective escape condition; (3) explain to the client; (4) declare HORS_PERIMETRE_PRIX_FIXEO; (5) provide additional quote; (6) obtain explicit client approval; (7) only then continue.
_meta.diagnostic_absorption_rule: If the client immediately accepts a qualifying standardized FIXEO repair completable during the SAME visit, the diagnostic fee (180 MAD) is ABSORBED into the intervention price. The client must not pay 180 MAD diagnostic PLUS the full standardized FIXEO intervention price for a simple same-visit standardized repair. If no repair is performed, or if the intervention requires a quote or specialized diagnosis, the 180 MAD diagnostic remains payable.
